verdict.rationale: Grafana documents rich visualization types, from time series to heatmaps to 3D charts, via panel plugins. It also documents dynamic, reusable dashboards with template variables shown as dropdowns. Shareability is only implied: dashboards can be defined as version-controlled code and provisioning files, but no direct sharing feature such as share links, embedding, or permissions is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dashboard sharing mechanisms (links, snapshots, embed, permissions), and independent hands-on corroboration of template variables and sharing.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build shareable dashboards with rich visualization types and template variables

citations.quote: Create dynamic & reusable dashboards with template variables that appear as dropdowns at the top of the dashboard.
The growing suite of Grafana visualizations, ranging from time series graphs to heatmaps to cutting-edge 3D charts, provide you several different ways to present your data within a panel
Fast and flexible client side graphs with a multitude of options. Panel plugins offer many different ways to visualize metrics and logs.
You can define data sources and dashboards using files that can be version controlled, making GitOps more natural.
This approach lets you define dashboards, data sources, and other configurations in code, enabling version control, automated testing, and reliable deployments through CI/CD pipelines.
